adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#ensure_embeddable, access is denied unless `URI(request.referer || '').host == SiteSetting.embeddable_host`. This means requests with a missing/stripped Referer header will always raise `Discourse::InvalidAccess` (e.g., if the embedding page sets `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer` or when navigating/embedding from HTTPS to an HTTP Discourse instance under the common default `no-referrer-when-downgrade` policy). That would break otherwise legitimate embeds because the controller requires a Referer to authorize the request.
